notes.title: Customization, favorite shapes, achivements & more languages!
notes.content:
Artists!

For those of you how saw our Steam Games Festival Goodbye stream, you already know waddup. For those of you that didn't, you can....

[h2]1. Watch our last [b]Kaleidocraft  [/b]Steam Games Festival stream right here:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=KGpwwHculEQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Please note that, besides the latest updates, we also told very accurate and historically proven stories about Midsommar. We also drew our 2020 Swedish Midsommar in a very realistic way.

[h2]2. Read the TL:DNR about our very first [b]Kaleidocraft [/b]Early Access update (0.7.3), which includes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The ability to customize your artist avatar, like so
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892310/a166453d5267c470a0be0e83430b3cef7bd59b09.jpg[/img]

[*] The ability to favorite shapes, for extra quick use
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892310/ae1904e0ea2cf502e44720e2bdbbb075e5a694c8.jpg[/img]

[*] Finally, thanks to the awesome work of awesome translator friends, whose names will all soon be listed in credits, Kaleidocraft can now be played in More Languages, with even more on the way!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892310/ed7e870c2c93c4f9a948cd01ea797bd10edc5daa.jpg[/img]

[*] ....oh, and!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37892310/ca9eae470c843c143c81c8f8360a2016871bfcea.png[/img]
[/list]

Enjoy, dear artists!

Laura & Anna
